lines.text: Rob Dyrdek is a serial entrepreneur, media magnate, CEO of Existence and Founder of Time…
CEO of @existence_io Founder of Time Creationism
Time has a structure that you create every day.

In 2015 I built a spreadsheet that would change my perspective on time forever. I realized time had a clear structure and everything unfolded in this structure. This Rhythm of Existence capacity planner is the genesis of what @existence_io would become 10 years later.
The Real You isn’t the one in your plans. It’s the one in your days. Most of us are living two lives: the one we imagine and the one we’re actually building. Only one of them is real.
Sometimes memory isn’t enough to show you how you lived. Account for it.

17 years old. My first contest as a professional skateboarder. I landed an ollie impossible lip slide down a handrail, becoming the first person to ever do it, and finished fifth. Up to that point, it was the greatest experience of my life. Now I can look back at that year through my @existence_io Grid.

Doubt doesn’t begin when you lose belief. It begins when friction starts slowing your momentum. Find the friction. Remove the resistance. Protect your momentum before doubt has the opportunity to take hold.
Your time tells you what happened. Your Reflections tell you what it meant.

One of the highest-energy Time Blocks I’ve ever had: 9.3. For the first time, we opened @existence_io to a cohort of paid users. Seeing people finally using it was truly such a thrilling experience. I also finished the outline for my philosophy that will eventually become a book and rounded out the week with family and fun in Mexico. The Real Me was closely aligned with the Ideal Me.
The person you intend to be vs. the person your time reveals.
Your life is shaped by what you repeat. Account for your time, and the patterns of who you’re creating become visible.
I hired the entire cast of Aladdin and 300 extras to propose to my wife. It was truly the beginning of the rest of my life. And now this moment is in @existence_io forever.
The more complete the picture of your time, the more complete the picture of you.
